artworks.title: Theseus and Sinis (kylix)
artworks.description: Munich kylix: Theseus bends the pine with Sinis — the Pine-bender caught in his own torture, Attic red-figure for the Isthmus road.

artworks.title: Theseus and Sinis (amphora)
artworks.description: Troilos Painter amphora in Rome: Theseus and the pine-tree brigand — Sinis' death as symposium-side myth.

artworks.title: Deeds of Theseus (cup)
artworks.description: Kodros Painter's deeds-of-Theseus cup: Sinis among the Isthmus cycle — the Pine-bender as one panel in Athens' favourite hero comic-strip.

popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Sinis the Pityocamptes — travellers tied to bent pines and torn apart when the trees sprang apart; Theseus returns the favour.

popCulture.title: Sinis
popCulture.description: The Pine-bender of the Isthmus — Theseus' second road-clearing victim after Periphetes.
